bestBets.overview: On pace runners 3,6,7 and 8. FEAZABEEL racing well has been a beaten favourite his past 2 runs at Scone. This looks a little easier so he is sure to be hard to beat. THINK I DO was very good when just beaten 2nd up at Goulburn over this distance. Fitter again now and well in after the 2kg claim. Her stablemate REMADOSI is probably looking for longer than the 1600 metres but she will be strong late. Rough chances to GIVE ME JOY who is rising in class and PHILADELPHIA STORM.

raceTips.comment: Feazabeel has shown enough ability in recent outings and looks suited by the race setup, with the ability to settle close enough to the speed before producing a sustained finish. Think I Do has been racing consistently and should appreciate getting conditions to suit, with enough tactical speed to hold a handy position and get every chance. Give Me Joy is lightly raced and still has upside, with the mare capable of improving again off her latest effort and drawing to receive a soft run. Remadosi has been competitive without winning and can be effective when able to settle behind the leaders, with a turn of foot that can bring her into the placings late.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners 1,6 and 11. INTO THE FIRE who looks the likely leader from barrier 2 and well in after the claim is sure to give a sight. He has a very good record at the track and distance. INNA ZOU resuming hasn't been seen at the trials. Her form last time in was very good and this doesn't look an overly strong race. PROPHET TIME is always a chance and from barrier 1 will get every hope. HELLO JACK another one resuming next best.

raceTips.comment: Prophet Time brings solid recent form into this event and looks capable of settling in a prominent position, giving the gelding every opportunity to build momentum when the pressure goes on. Into The Fire has been finding the line well and appears suited by the expected tempo, with enough strength to make his presence felt over the concluding stages. Vainstrem possesses useful speed and should be able to race within striking distance, which gives the gelding the chance to control his own race rather than settle too far back. Time And Rhythm has shown glimpses of ability and can improve with a more economical run, particularly if able to conserve energy before being produced in the straight.

bestBets.overview: No 6 the likely leader. POWERFUL PRAYER going well at the Provincials looks hard to beat in this grade. No problems at the 2000 metres but just the 1 win from 13 starts some concern. The maiden FILL UP ran on very strongly last start over 1600 metres. He gets a nice drop in weight today and he will enjoy getting to this distance. COOL AS POPEYE good all 4 runs this time in gets to this trip for the 1st time but she gives the impression she will be suited. LIYAH'S GIRL an easy winner at Newcastle last start is the other winning chance.

raceTips.comment: Powerful Prayer has plenty of race experience and can be competitive when able to find cover near the speed, with the gelding capable of sticking on strongly under pressure. Liyah's Girl has been building a consistent profile and looks ready to make her presence felt again, with a good cruising speed that should allow her to settle comfortably in the run. Cool As Popeye is another who should appreciate a positive tempo and has enough tactical speed to put himself into the race early, giving him every chance of fighting out the finish. Liyah's Girl looks the one with scope to progress further and should be suited by being kept within range throughout.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners 1,2,5,10,15 and 16. IKON PARK was strong breaking through at Albury at his 2nd race start. He draws badly but will go back and he should be strong late. SEGURO who has the pace to lead from barrier 3 drops in grade here and is sure to give a sight. XERXES ran well when resuming and then didn't handle the heavy track 2nd up. He also drops in grade here and can be an improver. Two other last start maiden winners DEEPLY and VANROSA can also measure up in this grade.

raceTips.comment: Deekaygeebee has been racing honestly and brings a solid level of form into this contest, with the gelding likely to appreciate a genuine tempo and the opportunity to build through his work late. Seguro has shown enough speed to settle forward and should be able to secure a favourable position, which could prove valuable when the field turns for home. Ikon Park has the ability to race prominently and has shown he can sustain a strong effort when asked for an extended run, making him a genuine threat. Deeply has been competitive in similar company and can be effective with the right trail, with the mare capable of closing strongly if the leaders overdo the early work.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners 1,6,9,10,12 and 13. ROSE AYE was well fancied when resuming in stronger grade at Randwick. She led there from the outside barrier and battled on really well. Fitter now she was a winner at Rosehill over this distance before going for a spell. COUGERS is another one who will be fitter after a fair return gets blinkers for the 1st time today. He has 1 win and 3 seconds from 4 previous 2nd up runs. BELLEISTIC KIDS normally runs well fresh and from barrier 3 will get his chance. MASTER OF DISGUISE can be an improver.

raceTips.comment: Cougars has shown good ability when able to find the right rhythm and should be capable of holding a prominent position, giving the gelding every chance to fight on strongly. Hurry Miss has plenty of speed and can put herself into the race early, with the mare likely to be difficult to run down if she gets the tempo within her favour. Who But Roo has been competitive and can finish off strongly when given the right passage, making him one to keep safe for the minor placings.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners 4,6 and 8. GIVE ME JOY has been freshened up since leading throughout for a very easy win here on the Acton track. She is sure to be hard to run down again in this. KENDALIA was well beaten on the heavy ground last start. His previous 2 runs were good but just the 1 win from 16 starts the concern. The ex Victorian MUST BE SAIN has been good all 4 runs up here on the Acton surface. GEM TYCOON from barrier 1 and after the claim has a place chance.

raceTips.comment: Cholante has been holding her form well and looks capable of settling in the first few pairs, giving the mare an ideal platform to produce her effort when the pressure increases. Kendalia has shown enough speed to take up a handy position and should receive every opportunity from there, with the mare capable of sticking on strongly through the closing stages. Gem Tycoon has shown glimpses of ability and can improve with a more favourable run in transit, with the gelding capable of finishing strongly when presented at the right time.
